verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-premises, or customer-deployed version of mParticle. Warehouse Sync only ingests data from the customer's own warehouse into the mParticle service, and the downloadable Events API spec only describes the hosted API. Neither is self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
